objectives.description: Create suite modelled on test-gate8-expected-new-distinction.sh, roots via common_test_repo_root/common_test_ext_root
Case D: unmappable path, sentinel fallback
Stub run-all.sh in the fixture (test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh precedent)
Run the new suite directly and confirm it passes

approaches_tried.approach: cache-write-eligibility fixture with no verify-deploy.sh copy inside it
approaches_tried.reason: gate-cache-lib.sh's implementation-digest component (gate_cache_resolve_verify_deploy/gate_cache_extract_invoke_body) reads gate8_run()'s own function body FROM A COPY OF verify-deploy.sh located under the TARGET fixture itself, to hash it as part of the composite cache key. A fixture with no such copy always resolves the key to CANNOT_COMPUTE, so --skip-unchanged never writes an entry regardless of narrowing. Fixed by copying $VERIFY_DEPLOY into the fixture at the expected path (never executed directly -- only read for hashing) and committing the fixture as a real throwaway git repo (the @extensions corpus resolution also shells out to `git ls-files`).

deviations.reason: Implemented as a multi-PATH union within the single fixture extension (two touched paths each pairing with their own real suite file) rather than spanning two literal agent-system/extensions/* directories. This still exercises suite_selection_select's union-of-resolved-suites path and the run-all.sh --only basename-acceptance smoke test the plan's research recommendation was aimed at (discovery-rule convergence between the two scripts), without the added fixture complexity of standing up a second fake extension tree.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- tested as a multi-path union within one extension rather than literally spanning two agent-system/extensions/* directories; same functional coverage)*
